extraction.provider_name: South Carolina Governor's School for the Arts and Humanities
extraction.notes: 2027 programs and application deadlines are published. Applicants must be South Carolina residents; these programs are not restricted to students already enrolled at the school. Direct opens of the department pages returned no readable text, so department facts were recovered from official search-index excerpts. Several programs' dates could not be recovered safely. The summer onboarding page still describes 2026; its dates were not treated as 2027 application dates.
